rubric: oaw.py remove oaw-codemap --apply reports status 'removed' / '完成' with exit 0 even when the user edited its SKILL.md, though the skill is still installed and doctor then reports 'OAW unhealthy ... Migration has unresolved conflicts'. The preview lists no conflicts either
trigger: After the journey setup, append a line to project/.agents/skills/oaw-codemap/SKILL.md, then run oaw.py remove oaw-codemap --target ./project --json (conflicts: []) and the same with --apply (exit 0, status removed); ls project/.agents/skills/oaw-codemap still shows SKILL.md; oaw.py doctor fails
user_impact: The user is told the built-in skill was removed when it was not. The edited skill keeps loading, the project is left in an unhealthy pending-conflict state, and scripts that trust the exit code carry on as if it worked.
intended_lookalikes: remove without --apply is only a preview (exit 0) and changes nothing
Removing a built-in skill goes through migrate and writes a backup under .oaw/backups/
After a successful removal, list no longer shows oaw-codemap and doctor stays healthy; other built-in skills remain
Running remove oaw-codemap --apply again after it was removed exits 2 with 'is not in this project's OAW recipe'
remove output lines mix English and Traditional Chinese
--force/--keep with a built-in skill are refused with exit 2
